text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is participating in one of 
the main events, the carrot-bread-eating 
race... however,

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-There are so many people. They're all... 
my fans, aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Trainer! W-W-What should we do...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't let the fans down! Just thinking 
about it makes my heart pound out of my 
chest...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had to relieve this tension somehow. As 
I was pondering how to do that—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's the Kikuka Sho lady! I saw your 
last race on TV! You were so super cool!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Um, me!?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be just like big sis one day 
too! Ehehe! Bye-bye!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... They left.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this brings back memories... I 
wonder if I was like that when I was 
little too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run like those Umamusume on TV. 
And become the best in Japan... that's my 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's right! This time, it's my 
turn to deliver dreams to that child.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right! Trainer, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having shaken off her nerves to 
take on the challenge, the result of the 
carrot bread-eating race was—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I lost~~~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
While I was running, I had a flash of 'I 
can do this!'... but then it just kind of 
slipped away...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... How pathetic of me. I really 
wanted to look cool in front of her.
choice_data_list: Let's get our revenge at the "Tenno Sho"!
Let's get our revenge at the "Tenno Sho"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Next time, I definitely 
want to live up to everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that her defeat at the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival had served as strong 
motivation for Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-We won! First place! We took first 
place, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
While I was running, I felt like 'I can do 
this!' And then, and then...! I feel like 
I've got a whole new way of running down!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! My, oh my! Special Week-kun, 
quite well done!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? Chairwoman!? Wh-what are you 
doing here!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Laughable! Of course I came to reward and 
praise your brilliant efforts!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Listen well to these cheers!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! That was amazing~! I'm gonna 
be rooting for you big time from now on!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis! Do your best in the Tenno Sho 
too~~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Keep working hard just like this! Hahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much! Thank you very 
much, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep working harder and harder... to 
become the number one horse girl in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that her success at the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival had served as strong 
motivation for Special Week.
